target: Eight public sampled-image changed/unchanged bits from actual immediate original source next observation. Preaction predictions only; no source truth or after frame provided before prediction.
current_public_input: Original MR15 public_raw_view 24 bytes and announced original native action, nothing private
history: Two preceding original public actions plus two preceding 8-bit postaction sampled image-change vectors; no cross-episode carry, use 255 action pad and zero byte-vector pad for first steps.

models.global: Training-only action-conditioned 8 Bernoulli frequencies; common prior.
models.current: 128 FIFO public-current-sample+action keyed 8 Bernoulli count vectors, backed off to frozen global posterior.
models.history: 128 FIFO public-current-sample+action+2 previously observed action/outcome pairs keyed 8 Bernoulli count vectors, backed off to same frozen global posterior.
models.ablation: History-key model trained with original histories, evaluated with history replaced by fixed all-pad values (same learned tables), to test retained historical dependence.

independent_unit: Original source reset seed, not multiple within-seed episodes or overlapping time steps
primary_metric: Prospective held-out eight-bit mean Brier aggregated per independent reset seed, per source family, per policy; current vs history and ablated history
dev_signal_go: History Brier strictly improves vs CURRENT control in both original actor policy distributions on DoorKey and is no worse than current on Empty; at least 3/4 DoorKey held-development seeds per policy improve; ablated-history must not outperform intact-history
capacity_accounting: Report actual table entries, serialized checkpoint bytes, complete worker CPU and OS max RSS, original source replay and all persistence. This diagnostic does not claim matched deployment resource parity.
g29_source_bound_atlas: BLOCKED pending reviewed legitimate repin and final native OS regression
if_fail: Keep negative; do not optimize MR19-MR33 recurrence or exploration. Next test independent authentic source families or a different information-sufficiency definition, without enlarging model.
